harvey.name: Harvey Lu
harvey.duties: TFT 显示 driver、绘图函数、角色 sprite、技能动画、UI、简单音效

en.duties: TFT display driver, drawing functions, character sprites, skill animations, UI, simple sound effects

yihao.name: Yihao Tao
yihao.duties: 玩法设计、摇杆和按钮接口、无线通信、消息处理、按键映射

en.duties: Gameplay design, joystick and button interfaces, wireless communication, message handling, button mapping

binqi.name: Binqi Liu
binqi.duties: 战斗逻辑和技能、接线和供电、元件布局、外壳 3D 建模和组装

en.duties: Battle logic and skills, wiring and power, component layout, 3D modeling and assembly of the enclosure

tasks.name: 完成项目 proposal
tasks.desc: 确定 Pocket Rivals 的玩法、硬件清单、分工和时间表。

en.name: Finish the project proposal
en.desc: Settle the gameplay, hardware list, division of work and schedule for Pocket Rivals.

tasks.name: 验证可行性并选定元件
tasks.desc: 确定 TFT、压力传感器、按钮的具体型号，核对 3.3V 兼容性和 pin 数量。

en.name: Check feasibility and choose components
en.desc: Pick the exact TFT, pressure sensor and button models; check 3.3 V compatibility and the pin count.

tasks.name: 采购硬件并研究接口
tasks.desc: 下单 TFT、Qwiic 摇杆、DFPlayer、扩展板等；阅读各模块的 datasheet。

en.name: Order hardware and study the interfaces
en.desc: Order the TFT, Qwiic joystick, DFPlayer, breakout boards, etc.; read each module's datasheet.

tasks.name: 组装硬件原型
tasks.desc: 在面包板上接好一块玩家板的全部外设。

en.name: Assemble a hardware prototype
en.desc: Wire up all the peripherals of one player board on a breadboard.

tasks.name: 做出简单可玩的 demo
tasks.desc: 单块板上能显示角色、读输入、播放音效。

en.name: Build a simple playable demo
en.desc: A single board can show a character, read input and play sound effects.

tasks.name: 验证单人模式
tasks.desc: 单个玩家板 + 中央板跑通一整轮战斗流程。

en.name: Verify single-player mode
en.desc: One player board + the central board run through a complete battle.

tasks.name: 完成硬件组装
tasks.desc: 两块玩家板全部焊接/固定，供电稳定。

en.name: Finish hardware assembly
en.desc: Both player boards fully soldered/mounted, with stable power.

tasks.name: 实现可靠的无线通信
tasks.desc: 协议、ACK、超时重发、掉线暂停已完成，电脑模拟器在 60% 丢包下通过；等上板实测（docs/hardware-test.md）。

en.name: Reliable wireless communication
en.desc: Protocol, ACKs, timeout retransmission and pause-on-disconnect are done, and the PC simulator passes at 60% packet loss; waiting for on-board testing (docs/hardware-test.md).

tasks.name: 设计并打印外壳
tasks.desc: 3D 建模、打印、安装屏幕/按钮/喇叭。

en.name: Design and print the enclosure
en.desc: 3D modeling, printing, and mounting the screen/buttons/speaker.

tasks.name: 集成并测试双人对战
tasks.desc: 两块玩家板 + 中央板完整对战，测试延迟和丢包。

en.name: Integrate and test two-player battles
en.desc: Full battles with two player boards + the central board; measure latency and packet loss.

tasks.name: 无线协议 + ACK / 超时
tasks.desc: 中央板中转 + step_id 去重已完成，radio_test 固件可测丢包 / 延迟 / RSSI；下一步按 docs/hardware-test.md 在三块板上实测。

en.name: Wireless protocol + ACK / timeout
en.desc: Relaying through the central board + step_id de-duplication are done, and the radio_test firmware measures packet loss / latency / RSSI; next, test on all three boards following docs/hardware-test.md.

tasks.name: Qwiic 摇杆 I2C driver
tasks.desc: joystick.c 已写好（TWIM1，带超时，可热插拔，死区 + 归一化有单元测试）；等摇杆到货上板验证方向和 pull-up。

en.name: Qwiic joystick I2C driver
en.desc: joystick.c is written (TWIM1, with timeouts, hot-pluggable, unit tests for the dead zone + normalization); once the joystick arrives, check directions and pull-ups on the board.

tasks.name: 按钮 + 压力传感器 (ADC)
tasks.desc: 按钮去抖和 FSR SAADC 读取已写好，pin 按草案；等确认 pin 分配和接线后上板校准。

en.name: Buttons + pressure sensor (ADC)
en.desc: Button debouncing and FSR reading via the SAADC are written, using the draft pin map; calibrate on the board once the pin assignment and wiring are confirmed.

tasks.name: ST7735S TFT driver (SPI)
tasks.desc: 初始化、画点/矩形/位图、局部刷新；尽早测帧率。

en.desc: Init, drawing pixels/rectangles/bitmaps, partial refresh; measure the frame rate early.

tasks.name: 角色 sprite 与技能动画
tasks.desc: 像素风小尺寸素材，控制 Flash/RAM 占用。

en.name: Character sprites and skill animations
en.desc: Small pixel-art assets; keep Flash/RAM usage in check.

tasks.name: DFPlayer 音效 (UART)
tasks.desc: 通过 UART 指令播放 microSD 上的音效。

en.name: DFPlayer sound effects (UART)
en.desc: Play sound effects from the microSD card via UART commands.

tasks.name: Pin 分配 + 供电方案
tasks.desc: 定稿每块玩家板的 pin 分配（见“硬件”页草案），确认供电电流够用。

en.name: Pin assignment + power plan
en.desc: Finalize the pin assignment of each player board (see the draft on the Hardware & pins tab) and confirm the power supply gives enough current.

tasks.name: 战斗逻辑状态机
tasks.desc: 回合、蓄力、防御判定、血量、胜负和重开；跑在中央板上。

en.name: Battle logic state machine
en.desc: Rounds, charging, block checks, HP, win/loss and restart; runs on the central board.

parts.name: micro:bit V2
parts.use: 两块玩家板 + 一块中央板

en.use: Two player boards + one central board

parts.name: 彩色 TFT 屏
parts.use: 每个玩家独立的游戏画面

parts.name: 按钮
parts.model: 16 mm 面板按钮（型号待定）
parts.use: 每人 4 个：技能、攻击、防御、菜单

en.name: Buttons
en.use: 4 per player: skill, attack, defend, menu

parts.name: 压力传感器
parts.use: 焰灵攻击测试、赛车油门、冒险绞盘

en.name: Pressure sensor
en.use: Ember's attack trial, racing throttle, adventure winch

parts.name: 音频模块
parts.use: 播放音效（48 个文件，见 docs/sd-card.md）

en.name: Audio module
en.use: Plays the sound effects (48 files, see docs/sd-card.md)

parts.name: 喇叭
parts.use: 每块玩家板的音频输出

en.name: Speaker
en.use: Audio output for each player board

parts.name: 距离传感器（计划）
parts.model: VL53L4CD 激光测距，Qwiic / STEMMA QT 接口
parts.use: 赛车挥手擦浪花、冒险手托升降门；每台掌机 1 个 + 1 个备用

en.name: Distance sensor (planned)
en.use: Wave to wipe the splash in racing, hold up the gate by hand in adventure; 1 per handheld + 1 spare

parts.name: Qwiic 连接线
parts.use: 把距离传感器串在摇杆后面

en.name: Qwiic cable
en.use: Chains the distance sensor after the joystick

player.name: TFT 屏
player.detail: 1.8" ST7735S，128×160，SPI（SPIM2，8 MHz）。所有画面都画在这块屏上；绘图核心和驱动草稿已写好，等上板核对偏移、颜色顺序和时钟。

en.name: TFT screen
en.detail: 1.8" ST7735S, 128×160, SPI (SPIM2, 8 MHz). Every screen is drawn here; the drawing core and a draft driver are written and wait for on-board checks of offsets, colour order and clock.

player.name: 板载喇叭
player.detail: micro:bit V2 自带的喇叭（P0.00，PWM 方波），没有延迟：界面音、节奏音和赛车引擎声都走它；计划中叶芽打节拍的拍子也由它发出。

en.name: On-board speaker
en.detail: The micro:bit V2's own speaker (P0.00, PWM square wave) with no latency: UI sounds, rhythm cues and the racing engine sound; it will also play the beat for Sprout's planned rhythm trial.

player.name: DFPlayer + 喇叭
player.detail: DFPlayer Mini，UART（P0 发指令），播放 microSD 卡里的音效（打中、全力一击、胜负），按优先级打断；卡里要放的 48 个文件见 docs/sd-card.md。

en.name: DFPlayer + speaker
en.detail: DFPlayer Mini over UART (commands on P0), plays sound effects from the microSD card (hits, full-power strikes, win/lose) with priority-based interrupts; the 48 files the card needs are listed in docs/sd-card.md.

player.name: 摇杆
player.detail: Qwiic Joystick（I2C 地址 0x20），走 P19/P20 的外部 I2C，不额外占 pin。菜单移动、赛车转向、冒险走格子。

en.name: Joystick
en.detail: Qwiic Joystick (I2C address 0x20) on the external I2C bus (P19/P20), so it takes no extra pins. Menu movement, racing steering, walking in adventure.

player.name: 按钮 ×4
player.detail: A / B 用板载按钮（确认 / 返回、格挡），S 技能、M 菜单是外接按钮。A / B 按下的时刻用中断记录，精确到 1 ms。计划：叶芽的攻击测试是跟着拍子按 A。

en.name: Buttons ×4
en.detail: A / B are the on-board buttons (confirm / back, blocking); S (skill) and M (menu) are external buttons. A / B press times are recorded by interrupt to 1 ms. Planned: Sprout's attack trial is pressing A on the beat.

player.name: 压力传感器
player.detail: FSR 压力垫，ADC（P1）。焰灵的攻击测试（捏住跟光带）、赛车油门、冒险里拉绞盘；开机或设置里可以校准。

en.name: Pressure sensor
en.detail: FSR pressure pad on the ADC (P1). Ember's attack trial (squeeze to follow the band), the racing throttle and the adventure winch; can be calibrated at boot or in settings.

player.name: 加速度计（计划）
player.detail: micro:bit V2 板载（内部 I2C，不占边缘引脚）。计划用于潮影的攻击测试：倾斜掌机让水珠停在浪尖上。待组里确认，要实测机壳里的轴向和舒适的倾斜角度。

en.name: Accelerometer (planned)
en.detail: On the micro:bit V2 board (internal I2C, no edge pins). Planned for Tide's attack trial: tilt the handheld to keep a water drop on the wave crest. Pending team confirmation; the axes inside the case and a comfortable tilt range need testing.

player.name: 距离传感器（计划）
player.detail: 建议 VL53L4CD 激光测距（Qwiic，I2C 地址 0x29），串在摇杆的 Qwiic 线上，不占引脚，朝上装、开孔。两个用途（已认可）：赛车里被浪花挡住时在掌机上方挥手擦掉；冒险里手悬在上方托住升降门，队友趁机过去（和压力垫二选一，取大的）。

en.name: Distance sensor (planned)
en.detail: Suggested VL53L4CD time-of-flight sensor (Qwiic, I2C address 0x29), chained on the joystick's Qwiic cable, no pins, facing up through an opening. Two uses (agreed): in racing, wave over the handheld to wipe off a splash; in adventure, hover a hand to hold up the gate while your partner gets through (either this or the pressure pad, whichever is stronger).

player.name: 外壳
player.detail: 3D 打印，固定屏幕、按钮、摇杆和喇叭。

en.name: Enclosure
en.detail: 3D-printed; holds the screen, buttons, joystick and speaker.

central.name: 战斗逻辑
central.detail: 中央板持有唯一可信的游戏状态（回合、血量、胜负）。

en.name: Battle logic
en.detail: The central board holds the single authoritative game state (round, HP, win/loss).

central.name: 无线协议
central.detail: 消息带序号；关键动作需要 ACK；超过 1 s 没收到玩家消息就判定掉线。

en.name: Wireless protocol
en.detail: Messages carry sequence numbers; key actions need an ACK; a player who sends nothing for more than 1 s is considered disconnected.

central.name: LED 点阵
central.detail: 中央板没有屏幕，用板载 5×5 点阵显示连接状态；无线实测时点亮的列数表示收包率。

en.name: LED matrix
en.detail: The central board has no screen, so its on-board 5×5 matrix shows the connection status; during radio tests the number of lit columns shows the packet rate.

player.name: 输入 driver
player.detail: 读摇杆（I2C）、按钮（去抖）、压力垫（ADC），合成一份输入快照；A / B 按下的时刻用 GPIOTE 中断记录，精确到 1 ms。外设都可选，光板子也能玩。还没上板实测。

en.name: Input driver
en.detail: Reads the joystick (I2C), buttons (debounced) and pressure pad (ADC) into one input snapshot; A / B press times are recorded by GPIOTE interrupt to 1 ms. Every peripheral is optional, so a bare board still plays. Not yet tested on hardware.

player.name: 按键含义
player.detail: 唯一知道“哪个键做什么”的模块：把输入变成意图（确认、下一只、攻击、格挡、换宠物），摇杆选宠物，压力垫或按住 A 控制指针。菜单键短按（松开时）打开换宠物框，按住 1 秒暂停。

en.name: Controls
en.detail: The only module that knows which button does what: turns input into intents (confirm, next pet, attack, block, switch pet), with the joystick selecting pets and the pressure pad or holding A steering the pointer. A short MENU press opens the switch box on release; holding it 1 s pauses.

player.name: 攻击测试
player.detail: 三层越来越快的追踪光带：光带位置只由种子和时间决定，和网页原型逐点一致；按在带内的时间比例给分。

en.name: Attack trial
en.detail: Three tracking stages, each faster than the last: the band's position depends only on the seed and time, matching the web prototype point for point; the score is the share of time the pointer stays inside the band.

player.name: 玩家协议
player.detail: 把意图变成带 step_id 的动作，重发直到收到 ACK；防守时在本机计时连续格挡，不受无线延迟影响。

en.name: Player protocol
en.detail: Turns intents into actions tagged with a step_id and resends until an ACK arrives; while defending it counts chained blocks locally, so wireless latency has no effect.

player.name: 屏幕与界面
player.detail: 绘图核心（16 色 4 bpp 双缓冲、按 8×8 块只刷新变化的部分）和 ST7735S 驱动草稿正在写，用测试和模拟器逐像素对齐；驱动要上板核对偏移、颜色顺序和 SPI 时钟。界面按 docs/ui-design.md 分 T0–T3 实现。

en.name: Screen and UI
en.detail: The drawing core (16-colour 4 bpp double buffer, refreshing only the 8×8 blocks that changed) and a draft ST7735S driver are being written and checked pixel-for-pixel against the simulator; the driver still needs on-board checks of offsets, colour order and SPI clock. The UI follows docs/ui-design.md in stages T0–T3.

player.name: 音效
player.detail: 声音调度：板载喇叭（PWM）放界面音、节奏音和引擎声（音量只有音效的 1/4），DFPlayer（UART）按优先级放音效；音效表从模拟器自动生成。主机测试通过，还没上板试听；游戏事件还没接上声音。

en.name: Sound effects
en.detail: Sound scheduling: the on-board speaker (PWM) plays UI sounds, rhythm cues and the engine (at a quarter of the sfx level), the DFPlayer (UART) plays sound effects by priority; the sound table is generated from the simulator. Host tests pass; not yet heard on a board, and game events are not wired to sounds yet.

central.name: 中央协议
central.detail: 管理两块玩家板的连接，回 ACK，每 100 ms 广播一次完整状态；1 s 收不到玩家消息就暂停。

en.name: Central protocol
en.detail: Manages the connection to both player boards, sends ACKs, and broadcasts the full state every 100 ms; pauses if no player message arrives for 1 s.

central.name: 回合状态机
central.detail: 唯一可信的游戏状态：派出、回合、防守、结算、倒下、胜负、暂停、再来一局。

en.name: Round state machine
en.detail: The single source of truth for game state: send out, round, defense, resolution, fainted, win or lose, pause, rematch.

central.name: 规则与宠物
central.detail: 伤害、格挡、护盾公式（纯数字函数），三只宠物的技能和属性相克；数值都在 game_config.h。

en.name: Rules and pets
en.detail: Damage, block and shield formulas (pure numeric functions), the three pets' skills and type matchups; all values live in game_config.h.

shared.name: 无线收发
shared.detail: 802.15.4 广播帧 + 发送队列；协议 v5：中央板发完整快照，玩家发带 step_id 的动作，重复和过期的包自动忽略。

en.name: Radio link
en.detail: 802.15.4 broadcast frames plus a send queue; protocol v5: the central board sends full snapshots, players send actions tagged with a step_id, and duplicate or stale packets are ignored automatically.

shared.name: 赛车核心
shared.detail: 双人赛车的物理、计圈、宠物特性（玩家板）和倒计时、比赛时钟、冲线顺序、技能（中央板），和模拟器逐步完全一致（27 万多项对照检查）。还没接到两块板的主程序里，画面也还没做。

en.name: Racing core
en.detail: Two-player racing physics, laps and pet traits (player board) plus countdown, race clock, finish order and skills (central board), step-for-step identical to the simulator (over 270,000 parity checks). Not yet wired into either board's main program, and no screens yet.

shared.name: 测试与模拟器
shared.detail: 约 30 万项单元和对照测试（规则、按键计时、声音、赛车和模拟器逐步对齐），加上丢包模拟器（0% / 30% / 60% 丢包下打完整局）和终端版对战 play.c。

en.name: Tests and simulator
en.detail: About 300,000 unit and parity checks (rules, button timing, sound, racing step-for-step against the simulator), plus the lossy-radio simulator (full matches at 0% / 30% / 60% loss) and the terminal battle play.c.

shared.name: 无线测试固件
shared.detail: 两块板互发，每秒报告丢包、往返延迟和信号强度，配 docs/hardware-test.md 上板清单。

en.name: Radio test firmware
en.detail: Two boards exchange packets and report packet loss, round-trip latency and signal strength every second, with an on-hardware checklist in docs/hardware-test.md.

shared.name: 网页对战原型
shared.detail: 和固件规则完全一致的网页对战，滑块调参后可以导出 game_config.h。

en.name: Battle prototype
en.detail: A web battle with rules identical to the firmware; tune values with sliders and export game_config.h.

shared.name: 掌机模拟器
shared.detail: 网页上的两台 128×160 掌机 + 虚拟中央板，可以登录、投票选模式，玩对抗、双人赛车（每只宠物一辆车，可选俯视 / 车后 / 第一人称视角）和双人冒险（4 个房间 + Boss），有暂停、掉线重连、设置和压力垫校准。

en.name: Handheld simulator
en.detail: Two 128×160 handhelds plus a virtual central board in the browser: log in, vote on a mode, and play battle, two-player racing (a kart per pet, top-down / chase / first-person view) and co-op adventure (4 rooms + a boss), with pause, reconnect, settings and pad calibration.

shared.name: 字库工具
shared.detail: 从开源像素字体 Fusion Pixel 12px（OFL）裁出界面实际用到的几百个中文字和英文字母，生成模拟器字库和以后固件用的 C 字库。

en.name: Font tool
en.detail: Cuts the few hundred Chinese characters and English letters actually used in the interface from the open-source pixel font Fusion Pixel 12px (OFL) to generate the simulator font and, later, a C font for the firmware.

shared.name: DeepSeek 助手
shared.detail: 把翻译、总结、生成测试数据这类便宜的活交给 DeepSeek，节约 Claude 额度；每次调用和结果质量都有记录（docs/deepseek-log.md）。

en.name: DeepSeek assistant
en.detail: Hands cheap work like translation, summarization, and generating test data to DeepSeek to save Claude quota; every call and its result quality are logged (docs/deepseek-log.md).
